name: vaadin-skills
description: Skills and tools for building high-quality Vaadin 25 applications with Java, Flow, and the Vaadin MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Style, design, lay out, and review Vaadin 25 application UIs.
interface.longDescription: Vaadin Skills gives Codex focused guidance for Vaadin 25 development, including Aura theming, visual frontend design, building form and entity-editor layouts, and reviewing code for workarounds where Vaadin already has an API. It also configures the Vaadin MCP server for current documentation and API lookup.
defaultPrompt: Build a form layout for this entity in Vaadin 25.
Style this Vaadin UI with the Aura theme.
Make this Vaadin view look polished.
